title: Extraction and purification of glomalin-related soil protein (GRSP) to determine the associated trace metal(loid)s
author: Li, Yuan, et al.

steps.title: Extract GRSP from soil
steps.instruction: Add 8 mL of 50 mM sodium citrate buffer (pH 8.0) to ~1 g of soil, autoclave at 121 °C for 60 min; repeat extraction cycles, collecting the supernatant after each cycle by centrifugation at 8,000 × g for 10 min, until the supernatant no longer shows the typical red‑brown colour. After the final cycle, centrifuge the combined supernatant at 10,000 × g for 10 min before proceeding.

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the protein concentration in the final GRSP extract using a Bradford assay with bovine serum albumin as the standard.

steps.title: Precipitate GRSP for metal analysis
steps.instruction: Adjust the GRSP extract to pH 2.5 with 1 M HCl, incubate on ice for 12 h, then centrifuge at 8,000 × g for 10 min to collect the precipitate.

steps.title: Redissolve and dialyze precipitate
steps.instruction: Redissolve the pellet completely in 0.1 M NaOH, transfer the solution to a dialysis tube (molecular‑weight cutoff 8,000–14,000 Da), and dialyze against deionized water for 72 h, changing the water every 8 h. Dialyze each sample separately.

steps.title: Digest raw soil for total metals
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.1 g of raw soil into a closed vessel, add 5 mL HNO₃, 2 mL HClO₄, and 1 mL HF, seal and let stand overnight. Then heat in an oven at 140 °C for 1 h followed by 180 °C for 5 h.

steps.title: Digest GRSP extract for metals
steps.instruction: Take 1 mL of dialyzed (or undialyzed) GRSP solution, add 5 mL HNO₃ and digest under appropriate conditions (as used for the soil digest).

steps.title: Analyze metals by ICP‑MS
steps.instruction: Analyze all digested solutions (soil total digest, GRSP digest, and BCR fractions) for As, Cd, Co, Cr, Cu, Fe, Ni, Mn, Pb, and Zn using an ICP‑MS (NexION 2000B, PerkinElmer, USA).

steps.title: Perform BCR sequential extraction
steps.instruction: Place 1 g of soil in a 50 mL centrifuge tube, add 20 mL 0.11 M acetic acid, shake for 16 h, centrifuge at 5,000 × g for 10 min and collect the supernatant (acid‑soluble fraction, Mac). To the residue add 20 mL 0.1 M hydroxylammonium hydrochloride (pH 2.0), shake 16 h, centrifuge 5,000 × g for 10 min and collect the supernatant (reducible fraction, Mred). Oxidize the residue by adding 10 mL 30 % H₂O₂ twice, heating in a water bath at 85 °C, then add 25 mL 1 M ammonium acetate buffer (pH 5.0), shake 16 h, centrifuge 5,000 × g for 10 min and collect the supernatant (oxidizable fraction, Mox).

steps.title: Test dialysis bias with spiked GRSP
steps.instruction: Prepare a metal‑spike solution containing As, Cd, Co, Cr, Cu, Fe, Ni, Mn, Pb, and Zn at 0.5 µg L⁻¹; place dialyzed GRSP into this solution, then dialyze the spiked sample separately alongside the normal (unspiked) samples using the same 72 h dialysis protocol with water changes every 8 h.
